title: Baby Jackie Ellison Outdoors, 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot photograph featuring a young baby, labeled on the front margin as 'Jackie Ellison', sitting outdoors on a blanket in a backyard setting. In the background behind the child stands a vine-draped trellis or shed next to a wooden fence. Handwritten blue ink on the reverse provides a poignant note stating 'died 13 mo. old'.
